**Nexo 1.3.1** fixes PlayStation games that ignored the controller in the Emulator. Nexo updates itself: look
for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** no server update needed; servers on v1.3.0 work with this version.

## Fixes

- **PlayStation controls:** some games ignored every button: Metal Slug X stayed on "PRESS 1P OR 2P START".
  The emulated DualShock switched itself to analog mode, which those games don't read. Now it starts in
  digital mode, like the real controller.

## Changes

- **PlayStation analog mode:** in digital mode the gamepad's left stick moves the d-pad, so you can still steer
  with it. Games made for the sticks turn analog mode on themselves. In other games, **L1 + R1 + Select**
  (keyboard **Q + E + Backspace**) works like the DualShock's ANALOG button. **Show controls** says so too.

## Install

Already on Nexo? Nothing to do: it updates itself.

On a **test build**? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo. Test
builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
